mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% is less than 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 6.0% signals persistent economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the 5-day windows following a month with UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 260) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing the S&P 500 to decline over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following a month with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, elevated housing starts (HOUST above 1500) signal an overheating economy that triggers profit-taking and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following a month with HOUST above 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of the 5-day windows following a month with INDPRO above 100.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll level above 140,000 (thousands of persons) indicates a strong labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following a month with PAYEMS > 140000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and low retail sales (RSAFS < 550000) signals a weak consumer sector that is not supported by housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following a month with HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS < 550000.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% over the past 3 months), higher discount rates compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle regime, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following a month with FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0%.
